data.description: Elegant Apartments in Dubai Creek Harbour: Discover Moor by Emaar
data.display_address: Moor at Creek Beach, Creek Beach, Dubai Creek Harbour (The Lagoons), Dubai
data.long_description:
Set in the vibrant Dubai Creek Harbour, Moor by Emaar offers a blend of contemporary design and sophisticated living. This residential project presents cozy one, two, and three-bedroom apartments surrounded by lush parks, providing residents with both comfort and a serene environment.

Designed with elegance and attention to detail, Moor features high-quality construction, innovative architecture, and spacious interiors with luxurious finishes. The residences are bright, welcoming, and include balconies with views of the creek and a beautiful 700-meter beach, just a few minutes' walk from the complex.

The development fosters a balanced lifestyle with a variety of amenities, including two town squares, a private pool, a shopping center with retail and dining options, an outdoor fitness area, children's play zones, a community room, barbecue facilities, and a scenic lawn. Residents can effortlessly combine recreation, relaxation, and socializing.

Moor's strategic location ensures easy connectivity, with just a ten-minute drive to Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai, and fifteen minutes to Dubai International Airport, making commuting around the city seamless and convenient.
